title: Offboarding IPEX Users
content:
General

Visit Onboarding and Offboarding of Team Members for general information regarding offboarding procedures.

DevOps

Below information is specific for DevOps- and cloud offboarding, and should be performed by the IPEX DevOps Team.

When notification of user leaving IPEX check that

  • User is not a member of DevOps created Security Group in AD, Users - Microsoft Azure

  • User is not a member of Azure DevOps organization, Settings · Users (iissab-ipex) - Settings (azure.com)

  • Send mail to GitHub support for removal from organization.

  • Send mail to devops@inter.ikea.com that user account has been handled.
